featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to express how truly satisfied I am with this KTM branch and the sincerity of its employees toward customer satisfaction. Honestly, even a 5-star rating feels insufficient for this showroom’s hospitality and their understanding of customer psychology.

Let me share my small story and how these amazing people—Mr. Ashish, Mr. Deepak, Mr. Sagar, Mr. Jaffar, and Mr. Ravi—made my purchase so smooth that the feeling was simply hard to put into words.

I visited the showroom on 03/01/26 on the recommendation of an old friend who had previously purchased a Duke from here. I came with my son to buy the KTM Adventure 390 X Plus after doing a lot of research. At first sight, my 9-year-old son fell in love with the bike—just like his father! He said, “Papa, please buy this one, it looks so cool.” (I currently own a 2012 Classic 350, which he doesn’t really like the look of.)

I approached Mr. Ashish—a perfect gentleman with a calm and reserved style—regarding the price and mentioned one important condition: delivery on 09/01/26, as it was going to be a birthday surprise for my son. He first asked whether I wanted to finance the bike. With a middle-class mindset, I said yes. He then introduced me to Mr. Deepak, who has an excellent understanding of finance. He patiently explained everything about ROI, tenure, and available finance options. Since I am very inquisitive about finance, I asked many questions, but he handled them all calmly and professionally. Finally, I agreed on a suitable finance plan.

I submitted all the required documents on 04/01/26. Honestly, I wasn’t confident that the bike could be delivered within five days, but Mr. Ashish assured me, “Don’t worry sir, we will do our best to deliver on time.”

And today, 09/01/26, I visited the showroom with my wife—and there it was, our new bike, ready for delivery! I also customized the bike with a few additional accessories. Mr. Sagar and Mr. Ravi are truly the best at what they do; they completed everything quickly and perfectly.

The delivery moment and the first ride were simply beyond words.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Ashish, Mr. Deepak, Mr. Sagar, Mr. Jaffar, and Mr. Ravi for making this experience so special.

P.S.: I hope I have spelled everyone’s names correctly—no mistakes intended!

featured_reviews.name: Shreyash Sachdeva
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a Triumph motorcycle owner with a 10-year extended warranty.

Recently, I faced multiple concerns during service interactions that I believe deserve official clarification.

1️⃣ I was informed that using engine oil other than “Prolube” could void my engine warranty.

However, the Owner’s Handbook specifies oil grade and standards (viscosity, JASO MA2, API SN), but does not clearly mandate a specific brand.

When I requested written confirmation of this brand requirement, none was provided.

2️⃣ I requested to observe my motorcycle during servicing. This was denied.

In previous services, certain parts were reportedly replaced, yet the removed parts were not returned to me.

When I requested documentation or video confirmation of replaced components, I was informed that such records were unavailable.

3️⃣ I contacted the official Triumph complaint channel seeking clarity. Unfortunately, my complaint was not formally registered, and no written clarification was provided.

As a long-term customer investing in extended warranty coverage, this experience raises serious concerns regarding:

• Warranty transparency
• Service documentation standards
• Customer visibility during maintenance
• Complaint handling protocol

This post is not an accusation. It is a request for accountability and clarity from the brand.

Premium engineering deserves premium service integrity.

Tagging for constructive resolution:

@Triumph Motorcycles
@Triumph India
@Shaman Motors

I hope this leads to official written clarification and improved transparency for all owners.

featured_reviews.review_text:

While I waited, Mr. Shetty kindly asked me to relax and even offered me coffee. Throughout the process, he and his team ensured that the problem was rectified with precision and care. Mr. Arash, AGM, also supported and facilitated this request.

I am extremely grateful to Mr. Shetty, Mr. Arash, and the technician for accurately resolving the issue and for providing such a positive service experience. This was truly a great experience with Triumph.

The professionalism, hospitality, and customer-centric attitude demonstrated by the team made this a truly positive experience. These individuals are a strong asset to Triumph and set a high benchmark for service excellence.
